links.comparator_used: Fully automatic AI-generated delineation without physician correction (AI-generated) and fully manual delineation
links.outcome: Delineation accuracy (vDSC, HD95), revision workload (VRI), and dosimetric deviation versus ground truth
links.effect: Mean vDSC 0.902 AI-assisted vs 0.896 AI-only vs 0.857 manual; mean HD95 5.20 vs 5.62 vs 8.01 mm; AI-assisted significantly better than AI alone for 6 of 11 OARs; median VRI 0.168 vs 0.181 (AI) vs 0.221 (manual); mean DVH deviation 4.2% AI-assisted vs 5.8% AI vs 11.1% manual
links.tradeoff: Physician editing requires time (median 10.0 min); some physicians showed decline in manual accuracy over time (12% of less-experienced), raising over-reliance concerns; AI-assisted showed no advantage over manual for trachea in Center 4 and EC patients, and aorta in Center 5.
links.quote: AI-assisted delineation also achieved significantly higher accuracy than AI delineation for 6 out of 11 OARs (54.5%): the heart, aorta, liver, trachea, spinal cord, and esophagus (Fig. 2a, b and Supplementary Fig. 3 ).

design_hint: clinician review/editing of AI-generated contours (AI-assisted vs manual delineation)
